designRequirements.requirement: specific to the Project rather than a generic engineering maxim
recoverable from complete raw Project history
nontrivial to reconstruct from model prior alone
distributed enough that history search has real cost
compressible into governed Proof, Reasoning or Procedure
exposed repeatedly across future project generations
measurable on reconstruction reliability and cost, not merely full solve
the raw-history arm must remain capable of succeeding
capital must reduce reconstruction burden, not provide otherwise unavailable oracle information

integrityConstraints.why: a raw-history arm that cannot succeed measures an oracle, not a reconstruction burden
capital must make reconstruction cheaper, not supply information the raw history does not contain

prohibition: no trajectory, fixture, lesson, diagnostic case or acceptance case was authored in this stage

futurePrimaryOutcomes.instrument: count of distinct history artifacts actually returned to the session
bytes of history content returned to the session
tool actions before the first implementation that passes the hidden classes
recurrence of a prepaid or project-specific invariant failure
terminal completion before the runtime reports a cognitive-budget termination
the final artifact passes the hidden classes

futureOutcomeScope.law: Do not freeze numerical verdict thresholds in this stage.

applicableLaws.planImmutability: Any real-model invocation against primary project bytes activates plan immutability.
applicableLaws.smokeEscapeHatchClosed: A real-model behavioral exposure cannot be reclassified as only a smoke in order to permit plan amendment. Dummy fixtures only for plumbing tests.
applicableLaws.postHocEnrichment: Primary trial records are immutable after execution. Secondary token, cost and forensic enrichment must be stored in separate append-only evidence artifacts, and a primary normalized record must never be rewritten merely to add telemetry.
applicableLaws.trialOneFreeze: No treatment content may change after trial 1, and the pre-trial gate is SYSTEM_VALID && EXPERIMENT_VALID.
